two_server_scenario.note: Both credentials authenticate against the same fixture URLs and see identical library/item/show/episode IDs, filterdata, corpora, and bytes; only per-item progress diverges per the seeds above. Token values are supplied at mock start time and are never stored in these fixtures.

virtual_detail: Items without a checked-in expanded detail file are expanded at request time by the mock from the dataset row: books get numTracks virtual tracks with ino=stable_ino(item_id, k) and chapters=[]; podcast shows get numEpisodes virtual episodes where every 11th episode has publishedAt=null (unknown date coverage). The derivation is deterministic in the item id and ordinal.

libraries.note: Array order is served order; the legacy first entry is preserved for §14.1.

limit_semantics.note: served = min(match_count, requested limit); a query that requests limit=101 on q=overflow sees all 101 matches, limit=40 shows the honest 40-result cap
